caption: Gritty East Coast boom bap with a vinyl-sampled soul piano, horn stabs and a crowd chanting in the distance, instrumental at 95 BPM in F minor. Mood: confident, street, the walk to the ring. Like a fighting game soundtrack recorded by a hip-hop producer with live session players: hard live drums with a tight snare and trap hi-hat rolls, a deep 808 bass, a concert grand piano, real bells and a warm analog synth pad. Big, polished studio mix with natural reverb, instrumental, no vocals.
lyrics:
[Intro - solo grand piano and ringing bells]

[Verse - hard live drums and deep 808 bass come in]

[Hook - full arrangement, bells and synth pad swell]

[Outro - piano and bells alone]
style: gritty East Coast boom bap with a vinyl-sampled soul piano, horn stabs and a crowd chanting in the distance
